metadata.label: Living Pearl Habitat
metadata.description: Image-textured organic pearl, delayed geometry tentacles, spectral veil and audio-driven habitat.

image.label: Habitat
image.description: Complete living pearl habitat before post processing.

controlDescriptions.copySize: Companion size relative to the main pearl.
controlDescriptions.orbitSpread: Distance of the drifting companions from the main pearl.
controlDescriptions.waveCount: Number of visible wave voices. Four keeps the band response legible.
controlDescriptions.waveMode: Flowing waves restores the musical sine ribbons. Measured FFT displays real frequency magnitudes.

metadata.label: Kaleidoscope Dream
metadata.description: The whole scene gently folds into a radial mirror, lingers, and returns to its original view.

image.label: Image
image.description: Scene with a smoothly animated mirror transformation.

controlDescriptions.kaleidoAmount: Maximum mirror strength in automatic mode, or direct strength with Occasional dream off.
controlDescriptions.kaleidoCycle: Leave the scene normal for most of each interval, then smoothly enter and leave a radial mirror.
controlDescriptions.kaleidoDuration: Seconds for smooth entry, an extended mirrored hold and smooth return.
controlDescriptions.kaleidoMotion: Amount of gentle rotation, drift and breathing zoom during the mirrored view.
controlDescriptions.kaleidoPeriod: Normal-view pause in scene-clock seconds between mirrored excursions.
controlDescriptions.sectors: Number of mirrored radial petals; rounded to a whole number.
